source.caption: Training-set weighted Spearman screening plots for the nine education systems. The horizontal dashed line marks the FDR-adjusted p-value threshold (q = 0.01), and the vertical dashed guides at |𝜌| = 0.20 are shown for descriptive orientation only. In the primary analysis, the 35 FDR-eligible variables with the largest absolute weighted Spearman correlations were retained in each education system.
